reviews.title: Blazing Fast!! Needs a heat sink.
reviews.comment: So this thing is super fast!! The only problem is that if you install it on a Linux OS variant then it needs to be formatted in order to be usable. The formatting was super fast. I own 2 4tb Samsung Evo 990 ssds and this one is way faster. I have it installed in the gen5 blazing slot on my Asrock Taichi Creator motherboard. It runs directly off the CPU lanes. I tested it and it does faster file transfer on average then the max my Samsung ssds have ever done.
reviews.author: Andrew and Danielle
